discount_probabilities = {
    "很低的折扣": 0.2,
    "较低的折扣": 0.3,
    "中等折扣": 0.3,
    "较高的折扣": 0.15,
    "很高的折扣": 0.05
}

# 生成随机数
random_number = random.random()

# 根据随机数选择折扣等级
discount_level = None
for level, probability in discount_probabilities.items():
    if random_number < probability:
        discount_level = level
        break
    random_number -= probability

    "较高的折扣": -70,
    "很高的折扣": -90
}
discount = discount_values[discount_level]

# 输出折扣值
print(f"折扣值：{discount}%")
